About us

LeadingAI-enabledcybercomplianceautomationandmonitoringforHROs

About Us

Cav delivers continuous cyber assurance to safeguard U.S. defense and civilian agencies, financial services, and critical infrastructure providers, ensuring their operations are always mission-ready. Founded and led by veterans of the U.S. military, the Cav team has firsthand knowledge and appreciation for the importance of speed and accuracy while operating no-fail systems.

About Us

Powered by the Compliance OS™ platform, Cav is committed to delivering the most reliable data in cloud, on-premises, and air-gapped environments, ensuring leaders are always mission-ready.

About Us

Cav is venture backed by First In and Ten Holdings and is trusted by leading federal agencies, financial services providers, and public sector organizations, including the United States Coast Guard, the United States Air Force, Fiserv, and BNP Paribas.

Core capabilities

WhatWeDo

  • Secure Compliance as Code

    01

    Compliance OS™ leverages agentic AI to automate, validate and monitor cyber controls in any environment, delivering 90% faster audit cycles and 95% evidence automation.

  • Accelerate ATO and cATO

    02

    Automated control mapping, real-time evidence ingestion, continuous monitoring, and AI-generated artifacts streamline the most complex processes for faster authorization.

  • Improve Productivity

    03

    Eliminating tedious, manual tasks mitigates human error and duplicative efforts, empowers workers to do more meaningful work, and saves organizations millions of dollars annually.
